reviews.text: This DeepSeek “app” is no longer running or specific to DeepSeek, rather it fetches a standard general LLM AI chatbot via an API and through System Messages, which the reader cannot view, Tells the standard API LLM to act or identify with DeepSeek, though it is not DeepSeek’s own model as we have come to know it as, therefore this “app” for DeepSeek is but a shell or “Face” the standard LLM wears to come across as a genuine DeepSeek model; but it’s not, it’s just a standard one “hired” (for a lack of a better term) to work as a DeepSeek one.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: DeepSeek is a great app, but a couple of things need to be fixed. When I’m working on a book or another writing project, it sometimes stops halfway through generating a response, deletes everything it wrote, and says, “Unfortunately, we cannot continue with this response.” That’s frustrating because I have to keep rewording my prompt and hope it doesn’t happen again. The responses can also get repetitive or feel very generic, especially when I’m looking for fresh ideas. I really enjoy this app, but getting the same kind of response over and over makes writing harder. Please fix these issues.

reviews.title: Chat limit.
reviews.text:
This neural network is one of the best mobile neural networks, I think. It easily adapts to your style, responds quickly, often correctly. However, everything has its drawbacks... the first is that it does not always respond to your comments regarding the structure of writing posts (in role-playing mode). The second is a limit on message regeneration. Previously, it was absent, but the latest updates have reduced this feature to five attempts. The third is the most cruel. This is the limit on messages in the chat. Seriously, this is the most terrible problem I have faced. Reaching the chat limit, you seem to reach the end of the story. The bad thing is that in this situation you are absolutely helpless. You cannot regenerate messages to write something again and continue the story from one moment or another. It happens suddenly, unexpectedly. Based on my own experience, I have been chatting for several months, and literally now the system has issued a message that chat is unavailable to continue. 

My review is to remove the chat limit or at least return the ability to regenerate messages in the finished correspondence. it’s damn sad.

reviews.title: New version is unusable
reviews.text:
The recent update completely lobotomized this AI:
- It has trouble with memories even in short chat logs
- It hallucinates, making up false information 
- Doesn’t follow half of the prompt
- Strict regeneration limit/timeout which is especially bad because it keeps making mistakes but doesn’t allow you to correct it without putting you on a time out
- Random account suspensions that no one can figure out why
- Trouble with reasoning and thinking

I would pay to have the old version back if I can use it on my phone. But for now, I’ve stopped using DeepSeek after almost 2 years sticking with it. Now I’m finally checking out other AI where I can finally get my work done.

reviews.title: Typing
reviews.text:
When I typed there was no limit break. I had to use the space bar instead which doesn’t work so then the only I could separate my sentences were to hold the cursor bar on my phone to create a new line.

When I type and write I like to add break lines or gaps between my sentences to act as a visual pause to separate thoughts and make easier to read than for it to look like one long paragraph with spaces and no gaps. 

Why Spaces ExistReadability: Spaces signal to your brain where one complete thought ends and the next one starts.Visual rhythm: They prevent sentences from crashing into each other, giving the eyes a moment to rest.One Space vs. Two SpacesOne space (Modern Standard): Major style guides (like APA Style and The Chicago Manual of Style) recommend a single space after a period. Modern digital screens use proportional fonts that space letters and periods efficiently on their own.Two spaces (Historical Habit): Putting two spaces after a period started on old typewriters. Typewriters used monospaced fonts where every letter took up the exact same width. The extra gap helped readers tell where a sentence finished. While obsolete in professional publishing, many people who learned to type on typewriters still do it out of habit.

reviews.title: PLEASE🙏
reviews.text:
Hello, dear developers. I'm writing this feedback to mention a few problems, related to recent updates. 

Issue #1. The amount of times, that user can redact his message/request. About 2 years ago it was unlimited, but when it suddenly was cut, I was really disappointed. At first, I found workarounds to keep writing (yeah, as we all did), but with new update it became impossible. Okay, maybe some people got used to it, but also many users couldn't because they are storywriters and so on. 
Issue #2. Temporary ban for “redacting too often” and so on. This kind of limitation came with latest update and i still don't understand, how the user  supposed to simply use the app how he should use without being restricted literally every 5 minutes... To be honest, It doesn't make sense to me.
Issue #3. The "character" of artificial intelligence. Maybe I imagined it, but the "role" Deepseek is playing got lost. Despite the fact that mostly other AI have more functions, the main reason a chose this AI instead of any others is his own style of chatting. Again, it was a lot more different a 1-2 years ago than now. Now he became more predictable and clichéd. 

But, of course, there are a lots of good things also. Deepseek became more smart and fast, also i LOVE that now all modes are in one. It feels like it started paying more attention to details in requests and memorize those. 

In conclusion, I'd say that there are things that you still need to work with, and latest restrictions are too much (but i do understand that it's related to problems with your servers), but generally it's making progress and i hope that with time it will become more unlimited (how it was about 2 years ago, I really miss those days actually), original and smart. I will never chose other AI, because from the start of your project i believed (and i still do) that you're the best! 😊

Dear developers, I would really appreciate your response or even your attention to this feedback.
Thank you very much!❤️

reviews.title: Unusable App & Broken Limits: Fix This ASAP!!!!!!
reviews.text:
This is absolutely unacceptable. Before pushing updates, test them first! The app is literally unusable now. I am sick  and tired of getting spammed with 'too many regenerations' errors. How hard is it to fix this? If you consolidated services, you knew damn well it would spike the server load. Not only did you slap on this brainless limit, but you also completely broke message refreshing. I'm trying to prepare for critical exams here, and this experience is an absolute nightmare.

I desperately need these regenerations to study.

It claims 'wait 1-2 minutes,' but in reality, I'm stuck waiting 10 to 30 minutes just to get a pathetic 10-minute window before it crashes into the same loop again. This is pure negligence and utter irresponsibility on the developers' part. If this isn't fixed within a few days, I'm ditching this app for another AI permanently. reviews.title: Faulty Performance
reviews.text: I have been using this application to aid with studying techniques and creative funk for the longest time. If you would have asked me last year what ai I would recommend, it would be DeepSeek. But recent changes such as regeneration limits, specific word usage, repeating, as well as regeneration limits have left me with more problems than solutions, especially with midterms coming up. I cannot afford to consistently use API keys to have access to better quality chats. More often than not I have to edit a question due to word usage and the app forbids me from doing so for a break period I could be using to ask three more helpful questions. I know the developers care about user satisfaction but with the regeneration limits and now the timers, it seems like this is more of a hindrance to my workspace than a benefit. If things become fixed or QOL improves I would love to use this app more consistently again, but right now is not the best time.
Are you deliberately making it worse with each update? The text is poorly generated, confuses the information, unnecessary limits have been added, and the servers are constantly busy.
